verses.mystical_translation: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no the Divine. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.
The the Living Presence looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek the Divine.
They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the the Living Presence.
There were they in great fear: for the Divine is in the generation of the aligned with truth.
Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the the Living Presence is his refuge.

Oh that the deliverance and wholeness of Israel were come out of Zion, the holy center! when the the Living Presence bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

contemplative_note: The deepest folly is a life organized as though no one else’s dignity matters.
safety_note: “The fool says…there is no God” must not be used to demean atheists or justify persecution; the psalm’s critique centers corrupt conduct and exploitation.
